protocol.sample: same frozen12F1documents/12prompt all80CID/158pairs; no error-based selection, no new prompt generation

protocol.scoring: Full string tokenize, longest common token prefix across ALL legal canonical PID subsets. For complete IDs lengthL and commonprefix s, forward ids[:-1], logits_to_keep=L-s; float32 log_softmax logit at s-1 predicts token s. Sum token logprob including right comma or }. EOS deliberately excluded: scores are complete-value partial-continuation events, not entire assistant answer likelihood.

protocol.length: Raw sum logprob, no length normalization/PMI/temperature. Longer subset has more factors; perCID common prefix terms cancel but length preference remains. One canonical inputPID ordering excludes other permutations and malformed continuations.
